blocks.text: This letter will continue more from the January letter describing the global worldwide economic problems facing all nations. It is beginning to become evident that there is no one-remedy known to fix this. As I noted in my past letters this is only the beginning of many more tragedies and earthshaking events to come. They have hidden from the people many problems that when revealed will be like shock waves. It is now evident that the loss of jobs has grown into the millions and more will follow. This will lead directly to the end of an era and the beginning of a new era under the anti-Christ system, for the crisis will be so great that they will be calling for a strong-man. I do not have space to continue on this subject because I have chosen a quote from Brother Frisby that would better explain. And now a quote from Neal Frisby.

A Further Look into the Prophetic Dimension – “When this world leader arrives on the scene, the world will be divided into four groups. . . the Northern and Eastern block of nations, and the Southern and Western block of nations! – He will dominate the Eastern world; he will finally control the Western world, making him a world dictator! – But, at the end of his reign, Russia, China and Africa rebel and come at him like a whirlwind in the battle of Armageddon!” (Dan.11:40-45) – “As we can see, this will involve Israel, Western Europe and the United States in a final catastrophic war! – We can see by the huge military build-up in the Middle East, and the armies surrounding Israel, that this prophecy is soon to take place! – There will, however, be a world peace treaty first, but 7 years later they still have this great battle. Blood will pour! – Man will almost be sinking to the brink of annihilation, but the Lord will intervene before total destruction!”

The Anti-Christ and the Gods of Science (Computers, Etc.) Riding the Waves of Progress – “The anti-Christ will exploit the potentials of science to further his own schemes! – He will usher in the Great Tribulation, regimenting the human race (global mark). Babylon the Great will work with this system!” (Rev. 17:5) – “She will be drunken with the blood of the saints who were not translated and will wage terrible persecution against the saints of the Tribulation era! . . Religious and economic freedom will not exist during this time!” – “After the Translation the anti-Christ will impose ‘his mark’ to try to stamp out those believing in Jesus!” Nahum 2:9, “reveals during that time there as no end to the gold and silver they had stored up! . . . And this was just a few verses after the prophet had spoken of the fiery chariots! (Modern day Warfare, Nah.3:3) So in our age they also have stored up most of the silver and gold! . . . And prophecy has forewarned us soon a super human dictator will control this! . . . And by the prophetic gift it is predicted in the not too distant future the world will have a new economy and social order, a new political system and new deceptive religion! For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth!” (Luke 21:35) – Nah. 1:5-6 reveals the total end of this! It says, ‘The earth is burned at his presence!’ . . . And he will even melt the hills, etc.! This is Armageddon! So the prophet (Dan.9:26) wrote, ‘the end thereof shall be with a flood!’ . . . And the Scripts predict a sudden rush of political, financial and scientific changes are just ahead! Jesus’ return is soon!”

“The Bible speaks of His coming, as like unto a thief!” (II Pet.3:10 – Rev. 16:15) – “Remember Jesus said, as in an hour that ye think not! (Matt.24:44) Nevertheless this is a dual prophecy! But now let us give some real Scriptures of the Translation before the Tribulation!” – I Cor. 15:52, “reveals that we will be caught up in a twinkling of an eye. – This matches what Jesus said, As the lightning flashes from the east to the west! His coming will be suddenly! It will be like a thief, in other words when no one is expecting it and when most are unprepared!” – I Thess. 5:2, “Paul says again, as a thief in the night!” – I Thess. 4:14- 17, “definitely reveals the Translation of the Saints! And Paul said in verse 18 to comfort one another with these words! – If the Bride was going through the Great Tribulation there would not be much comfort in these words!” – “The Bride will possibly be here for a while during the first part of the 7-yr. period, but according to Scriptural evidence the Bride will not be here during the last 42 months of the Great Tribulation!” – Luke 21:35, “reveals it will take the whole world by surprise!” – Verse 36, “Jesus commands us to watch and to pray always! so that the Bride may escape all these things! He would not have said we would escape these things if the Bride was going through the total Tribulation!” – “She, the elect church is going up! There is definitely a Translation for the ones He loves in a rapturous joy!” – “Remember God protected Elijah and Enoch and translated them! The same will occur to the elect!” (II Kings 2:11 – Heb. 11:5) End quote. Evidence of the soon return of our Lord Jesus is everywhere. The immoral, political and religious connections coming together certainly shows time is short. That brings us to two wonderful Special Writings I’m releasing called “Whirlwind Prophecy – The Translation” and “Gold and the Economic Crisis” as well as a new DVD “The Bible Wheel – Part 2” (see offer below). Your prayers and support will help continue to publish this important message. God will continue to bless and meet your needs through these troublesome times. Your Brother in Christ,
